discriminatingTest: Configure any model provider and run one task whose answer the repository does not compute. If a local runtime can serve it, the gap was authorship rather than the provider.

revision.reason: The 1.0.0 verdict rested on four negative probes that were never pushed. Re-probing split the gate into a runtime half and a weight half, and the runtime half is open. Section 007 requires the observation to beat the prior belief.
revision.whatTheEarlierVerdictGotWrong: It read 'no runtime installed' as 'no runtime installable' and therefore attributed the whole gap to an external gate.

docs/CAPABILITY_GENOME_CANON.md requires independent STATIC, SEMANTIC and SANDBOX evidence plus resolved license before a world artifact may execute. No weight artifact in this environment carries any of the three.

blockerPrecision.note: Two independent blockers. Opening the network policy alone would not make a downloaded model selectable, because the Genome admission gate would still refuse it. Both must open.

whatWouldChangeThisVerdict: A provider credential in the environment.
A policy-permitted weight host, plus STATIC, SEMANTIC and SANDBOX evidence for the exact artifact, plus a resolved SPDX license.
A judgement task whose answer the repository can verify without a model, which would make the capability dimension measurable without any provider at all.
consequence: The capability-by-judgement dimensions stay unscored. This does not block bottleneck discovery, generalization, meta-improvement, reality calibration, life transfer or economic transfer, none of which require a model provider. Those were treated as blocked by association and are not.
